literal: Having comforted, 'fear not', he who said, if he departs, assuring word to those who trusted, is there fault?
translation: If he who comforted me and said 'fear not' departs, is it the fault of those who trusted his assuring words?
modern: அன்பு செய்து 'அஞ்சாதே' என்று சொன்னவர் இப்போது பிரிந்து செல்வாரானால், அவர் சொன்ன உறுதியான சொற்களை நம்பியவர்களுக்கு ஏதாவது குற்றமுண்டோ?
explanation: The heroine speaks these words in grief when the hero, who previously promised never to leave her, departs. She recalls how he comforted her with the words 'fear not' (அஞ்சல்). She asks rhetorically if the fault lies with her for trusting his clear, assuring words (தெளித்த சொல்). The couplet highlights the pain of broken promises in love and shifts the blame from the trusting lover to the one who breaks the vow.
